title: Games and Strategy
description: Von Neumann and Morgenstern: when what is best for you depends on what others do, choosing becomes a game, and games have mathematics. Unlocks the Strategy Table.

puzzle.goal: You play your first move with chance p and then win a; otherwise you play your second and win b. Write what you win on average, W.
puzzle.name: Mixed strategy
puzzle.ask: Find W for p = 0.3, a = @{a} and b = @{b}.
puzzle.method: Each outcome counts in proportion to how often it happens.
